title: BPW-2026-0569
text:
[BUREAU OF SANITATION]
BPW-2026-0569
CD 6
REQUEST FOR AUTHORITY – CAROLLO ENGINEERS, INC.
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the Director and General Manager of the Bureau of Sanitation to issue Amendment No.1 to Task Order Solicitation (TOS) S-42B to Carollo Engineers increasing the ceiling from $4,320,000 (including $432,000 contingency) to $12,585,409 (including $1,182,000 contingency); and
NO Change to TOS 42A.
(W.O.: SZD11259, C-145640)
